Justification: PayNest requires formal security policies approved by management and communicated to all 25 staff and field agents across credit savings deposit and wallet operations.

Justification: Owners must be clear for security tasks across staff, field agents and suppliers.

Justification: With one front-end and one back-end developer, nobody should write, approve and release the same change.

Justification: Managers must require staff and agents to follow security rules.
Notes_and_Evidence: Add security duties to manager objectives and reviews.

Justification: Incidents may need reporting to the Bank of Ghana, Data Protection Commission and Cyber Security Authority.
Notes_and_Evidence: Keep a contact list with reporting triggers and timelines.

Justification: Sector and security groups give early warning of threats and fraud.

Justification: Monitoring fintech and regional threat patterns helps anticipate fraud social engineering USSD/API abuse and connectivity/power risks.

Justification: Changes to core systems APIs USSD integration or Tamale infrastructure must embed security requirements before deployment.
Notes_and_Evidence: Include security checks in release/change workflows for Onix core and channel updates.

Notes_and_Evidence: Add asset return to the exit checklist.

Justification: Access to core banking/ledger databases financial records and administrative interfaces must be restricted by role and least privilege.
Notes_and_Evidence: Enforce RBAC PAM and least privilege across Onix core systems databases and staff accounts.

Justification: Unique user identities and lifecycle management are required for all 25 staff field agents and system/service accounts.
Notes_and_Evidence: Standardize provisioning role changes and immediate offboarding/revocation for staff and field agents.

Justification: Strong authentication is essential to protect core systems administrative access staff accounts and field agent sessions.
Notes_and_Evidence: Enforce MFA strong credentials/PINs/biometrics and secure secret/token management.

Justification: Access must be approved, reviewed and removed when no longer needed.
Notes_and_Evidence: Record approvals and run quarterly access reviews.

Justification: PayNest relies on Onix Microsoft MTN Starlink USSD provider and independent security testers while excluding suppliers' internal equipment/buildings from direct control.
Notes_and_Evidence: Track vendor SLAs NDAs rules of engagement and supplier risk reviews in 04-third-party-risk.

Control_Title: Addressing information security within supplier agreements
Justification: Contracts and engagements with suppliers/testers must define security expectations confidentiality and incident notification duties.
Notes_and_Evidence: Document security/confidentiality terms and pentest scope/NDA requirements before onboarding or testing.

Control_Title: Managing information security in the ICT supply chain
Justification: Software libraries, hardware and ICT services can introduce weaknesses.
Notes_and_Evidence: Check key components and supplier dependencies.

Control_Title: Monitoring, review and change management of supplier services
Justification: Supplier performance and changes can affect services and security.
Notes_and_Evidence: Review suppliers at the cadence in the supplier register.

Control_Title: Information security for use of cloud services
Justification: PayNest uses Microsoft 365 under a non-sensitive use only boundary and interacts with cloud/hosted dependencies under shared responsibility.
Notes_and_Evidence: Configure M365 tenant security/DLP and strictly enforce non-sensitive data boundaries.

Control_Title: Information security incident management planning and preparation
Justification: PayNest needs clear roles escalation paths and runbooks for security incidents across Tamale Onix mobile/web/USSD and field operations.
Notes_and_Evidence: Prepare incident response plan and escalation contacts in 05-assurance-and-evidence.

Control_Title: Assessment and decision on information security events
Justification: Events need consistent triage to identify real incidents.
Notes_and_Evidence: Apply the runbook severity matrix and record decisions.

Justification: Incidents must be contained and resolved using agreed procedures.
Notes_and_Evidence: Follow the incident response runbook and record actions.

Justification: Lessons reduce repeat incidents.
Notes_and_Evidence: Hold post-incident reviews and track corrective actions.

Justification: Fraud and breach cases may need reliable evidence.
Notes_and_Evidence: Define how evidence is collected, stored and handed over.

Justification: Disruptions to MTN internet power in Tamale Onix hosting or USSD/mobile channels require continuity measures to protect security and availability.
Notes_and_Evidence: Pair MTN-to-Starlink failover and UPS/generator power with security monitoring during outages.

Justification: Core systems databases and Tamale encrypted backups require tested recovery and continuity readiness aligned with business tolerances.
Notes_and_Evidence: Conduct periodic restore drills on the Tamale encrypted backup server and failover tests in Tamale.

Control_Title: Legal, statutory, regulatory and contractual requirements
Justification: PayNest handles deposits and personal data under Ghanaian law and Bank of Ghana rules.
Notes_and_Evidence: Keep a register including Act 930, Act 843, Act 1038 and CISD 2026; confirm applicability.

Justification: In-house code and licensed software must be used lawfully and protected.
Notes_and_Evidence: Track software licences and code ownership.

Justification: Financial and customer records must stay complete and protected.
Notes_and_Evidence: Set retention, protection and disposal rules.

Justification: PayNest processes customer and staff personal data.
Notes_and_Evidence: Confirm data protection registration and apply privacy procedures.

Justification: An impartial review tests whether the ISMS works.
Notes_and_Evidence: Schedule a review by someone independent of the work reviewed.

Control_Title: Compliance with policies, rules and standards for information security
Justification: Policies only help if compliance is checked.
Notes_and_Evidence: Run periodic compliance checks and record gaps.

Justification: Written procedures reduce errors and reliance on individuals.
Notes_and_Evidence: Document backup, failover, release and reconciliation procedures.

Justification: Background and reference checks are appropriate before granting access to financial operational or customer-related environments.
Notes_and_Evidence: Apply pre-employment and field agent vetting proportionate to role sensitivity.

Justification: Staff and field agents must accept confidentiality obligations and security responsibilities before accessing PayNest systems or data.
Notes_and_Evidence: Include confidentiality and security compliance terms in employment and agent agreements.

Control_Title: Information security awareness education and training
Justification: All 25 staff and field agents need practical training on phishing social engineering M365 non-sensitive boundaries and field device/KYC care.
Notes_and_Evidence: Deliver role-tailored onboarding and periodic refreshers for office/remote staff and field agents.

Justification: A fair process is needed for security policy breaches.
Notes_and_Evidence: Include security breaches in the HR disciplinary process.

Control_Title: Responsibilities after termination or change of employment
Justification: Access and company/field devices must be promptly revoked or returned when staff or field agents leave or change roles.
Notes_and_Evidence: Execute checklist-driven access removal and device/token recovery upon exit or transfer.

Justification: Staff, agents and testers access confidential information.
Notes_and_Evidence: Sign agreements before granting access.

Justification: Some staff work remotely.
Notes_and_Evidence: Set remote working rules for devices, networks and access.

Justification: Staff and agents must be able to report problems quickly.
Notes_and_Evidence: Publish a reporting channel and include it in training.

Justification: PayNest operates a Tamale office with a backup server and power infrastructure while Onix Data Centre provides primary hosting.
Notes_and_Evidence: Control physical entry to sensitive office/server/backup areas in Tamale and verify Onix physical controls.

Justification: Restricting entry to sensitive areas in the Tamale office protects network gear UPS/generator controls and the encrypted backup server.
Notes_and_Evidence: Limit access to server/backup/network equipment areas to authorized personnel and log visits.

Justification: The Tamale office holds customer-facing work and the backup server.
Notes_and_Evidence: Lock and restrict sensitive rooms.

Justification: Monitoring physical areas and environmental/power alerts in Tamale helps detect unauthorized access or facility faults early.
Notes_and_Evidence: Monitor Tamale equipment rooms/areas and power/backup status alarms.

Control_Title: Protecting against physical and environmental threats
Justification: Fire, flood, heat and dust can damage equipment.
Notes_and_Evidence: Assess site threats and provide fire and environmental protection.

Justification: Work near the backup server and network equipment needs rules.
Notes_and_Evidence: Define and supervise access and conduct in the server room.

Justification: Protecting screens and physical workspaces in Tamale and remote locations reduces casual viewing or exposure of sensitive records.
Notes_and_Evidence: Enforce auto-screen lock and clean workspace habits for staff handling internal or Restricted data.

Justification: Equipment must be placed to limit damage and unauthorised access.
Notes_and_Evidence: Rack equipment away from water, heat and public areas.

Justification: Remote staff and field agents carry devices outside the office.
Notes_and_Evidence: Set care, encryption and loss reporting rules.

Justification: Removable and backup media can expose sensitive data.
Notes_and_Evidence: Restrict, encrypt, track and securely dispose of media.

Justification: Tamale operations rely on UPS and a backup generator alongside MTN and Starlink connectivity to sustain critical functions.
Notes_and_Evidence: Maintain UPS health generator fuel/servicing and regular failover testing.

Justification: Network and power cabling in the Tamale office and backup server setup must be protected from tampering or accidental damage.
Notes_and_Evidence: Route and secure LAN/power/uplink cabling cleanly within the Tamale office.

Justification: Servers, UPS and generator need maintenance to stay available.
Notes_and_Evidence: Keep a maintenance schedule and records.

Control_Title: Secure disposal or re-use of equipment
Justification: Retired equipment may still hold data.
Notes_and_Evidence: Wipe or destroy storage and record it.

Justification: Office laptops/workstations and field agent mobile devices are in scope whereas customers' own phones/computers are excluded from direct control.
Notes_and_Evidence: Enforce MDM/EDR disk encryption screen lock and remote wipe on PayNest-managed devices.

Justification: Privileged access to core banking/ledger systems databases and network/cloud consoles carries high impact and requires strict control.
Notes_and_Evidence: Restrict admin privileges review them regularly and require strong MFA/PAM.

Justification: Users should see only the data their role needs.
Notes_and_Evidence: Enforce role-based restrictions in applications and databases.

Justification: In-house code is critical and held by two developers.
Notes_and_Evidence: Use a controlled private repository with MFA and change history.

Justification: Strong authentication mechanisms protect user and administrative sessions across systems and channels.
Notes_and_Evidence: Enforce MFA and strong session/token controls across admin and operational portals.

Justification: Growth or transaction peaks could slow or stop services.
Notes_and_Evidence: Monitor capacity and plan upgrades.

Justification: Malware controls protect endpoints and servers from infection and lateral movement.
Notes_and_Evidence: Deploy EDR/anti-malware and keep OS and software updated.

Justification: Unpatched flaws in core software APIs web/mobile apps or network components create exploitable entry points.
Notes_and_Evidence: Track vulnerabilities patch on schedule and validate via independent security testing.

Justification: Wrong settings on servers and networks create weaknesses.
Notes_and_Evidence: Set secure baselines and review changes.

Justification: Data no longer required should be removed.
Notes_and_Evidence: Delete data according to retention rules.

Justification: Developers and testers should not see real customer data unnecessarily.
Notes_and_Evidence: Mask or use synthetic data outside live systems.

Justification: Preventing unauthorized exfiltration or misplacement of customer PII financial records and M365 data is critical.
Notes_and_Evidence: Apply DLP rules M365 non-sensitive data restrictions and agent/endpoint data controls.

Justification: Backups of core systems and databases including the encrypted backup server at the Tamale office are vital for recovery.
Notes_and_Evidence: Automate encrypted backups and verify restoration regularly.

Justification: Services need enough redundancy to meet availability needs.
Notes_and_Evidence: Define availability needs and check redundancy against them; backups alone are not redundancy.

Justification: Comprehensive security and transaction logs are needed to investigate incidents audit changes and reconcile financial activity.
Notes_and_Evidence: Centralize and protect audit/transaction logs and restrict log tampering.

Justification: Unusual activity must be detected on systems and transactions.
Notes_and_Evidence: Set alerts and assign someone to review them.

Justification: Consistent time is needed for logs and transaction reconciliation.
Notes_and_Evidence: Synchronise systems to approved time sources.

Justification: Powerful tools can bypass application controls.
Notes_and_Evidence: Restrict and log their use.

Control_Title: Installation of software on operational systems
Justification: Unapproved software can break or compromise live systems.
Notes_and_Evidence: Allow only approved, tested installations.

Justification: Segmenting the Tamale LAN/Wi-Fi and securing network boundaries protects internal systems and administrative paths.
Notes_and_Evidence: Segment VLANs isolate guest traffic and monitor network health and failover.

Justification: Internet and USSD connections need defined security and service levels.
Notes_and_Evidence: Define and monitor security requirements for each service.

Justification: Separating networks limits the spread of attacks.
Notes_and_Evidence: Separate server, management, staff and guest networks.

Justification: Malicious websites can infect staff devices.
Notes_and_Evidence: Block known harmful sites.

Justification: Encryption protects Restricted and Confidential data at rest and in transit including Tamale backups and mobile/web/USSD/API traffic.
Notes_and_Evidence: Use approved encryption standards and manage cryptographic keys securely.

Justification: In-house software backend APIs and mobile/web front ends require secure coding testing and release controls.
Notes_and_Evidence: Incorporate code review input validation auth checks and security testing prior to release.

Justification: Customer-facing mobile app web portal and USSD integration must enforce strong transport security session integrity and transaction safety.
Notes_and_Evidence: Enforce TLS API auth rate limiting idempotency and session timeout controls.

Control_Title: Secure system architecture and engineering principles
Justification: Systems handling money and personal data need secure design.
Notes_and_Evidence: Document and apply design principles.

Justification: In-house code can introduce exploitable flaws.
Notes_and_Evidence: Apply coding standards, peer review and automated scanning.

Control_Title: Security testing in development and acceptance
Justification: Changes must be tested before release.
Notes_and_Evidence: Test before release and use an independent tester for major releases.

Justification: Not applicable: all software is built by two in-house developers. Review if any development is outsourced.
Notes_and_Evidence: No action while development stays in-house.

Justification: Development and testing must not affect live customer data or services.
Notes_and_Evidence: Maintain separate environments and accounts.

Justification: Uncontrolled changes can cause outages or weaknesses.
Notes_and_Evidence: Record, test, approve and be able to reverse changes.

Justification: Test data must be selected and protected.
Notes_and_Evidence: Use synthetic data; approve and protect any exception.

Control_Title: Protection of information systems during audit testing
Justification: Audits and tests must not disrupt live services.
Notes_and_Evidence: Agree scope, timing and access before testing.
